governance.note: Continuation of the pjm-53 zonal-gas keeper stack (pjm-48 coal keeper + pjm-49 MISO/NYISO realized-LMP heat-rate anchors + pjm-50 firm-export floor / losses hurdle / TVA-LGEE seams + pjm-51 Southeast gas-INELASTIC affine reference price + the pjm-52 coal-bituminous 3-lever sticky-online stack + pjm-53 pjm_zonal_gas_basis), all previously attested. NEW this run: ONE structural lever family, pjm_congestion, calibrated entirely to MEASURED PJM transfer/interchange data (data/raw/iso-specific-transmission/), no value tuned to the price/export residual (rules #11/#12). (A) Each priced PJM_external->border link's signed flow is capped per (month x hour-of-day) at the MEASURED per-border net-interchange envelope (p95; eia_loader.pjm_zonal_interchange_envelope, from the PJM import_export_act_sch_interchange tie-flow file attributed to the model border zone each tie physically enters) -- import direction up, export direction down, as asymmetric per-hour interface groups (the same dispatch machinery as the CAISO per-hub corridor caps). The dominant tie direction keeps a generous capability ceiling the LP clears below; the minor direction collapses toward ~0 (EMAAC/AEP import ~0, Dominion export ~0), so the single price hub can no longer wheel ~30 GW uncongested into the 5 border zones. (B) The internal interfaces with a confident named-interface mapping are tightened to their MEASURED PJM transfer-limit postings (constants.PJM_MEASURED_INTERNAL_TTC, pooled 2023-25 median: ComEd->AEP 6000->2900 from 50045005, AEP->DOM 4069->4050, AP-South 4453->3900, Bedington-BlackOak 1947->1850). Both are forward-reproducible measured network limits that regenerate for a forward year from forward interchange/transfer schedules and respond to changed conditions; no residual-tuned adder, no load proxy, no haircut, no output pinning. RESULT: the lever WORKS as designed and is structurally correct -- the PJM copper-plate is BROKEN. The zonal LMP spread, which was EXACTLY $0.00 in all 8760 hours of all three years in pjm-53, now opens to $0.42 / $1.19 / $1.63 (2023/24/25) with congestion across the binding ComEd->AEP cut in a material share of hours: ComEd (the far-west MISO-adjacent coal/wind belt) decouples DOWN to $25.98 / $23.89 / $33.41 vs the ~$26.40 / $25.03 / $35.03 body. The over-export shrinks from pjm-53's +49/+61/+58 toward +47.3 / +50.4 / +49.9 TWh. BUT the dominant FIT misses do NOT close, and the load-weighted LMP is marginally MORE under (C3a -4.7% / -12.4% / -15.8% vs pjm-53 -3.9% / -10.4% / -14.4%): gas over +10.8% / +15.1% / +15.1%, COAL_BIT under -15.6% / -15.3% / -4.2%, net export still well over the measured +40.0 / +32.7 / +18.0. DIAGNOSIS (redirects the next lever): the measured network, faithfully represented, breaks the copper-plate but only at the ONE cheap ComEd seam -- the east (EMAAC/SWMAAC/Dominion) barely separates UP (east-west +$0.09 / +$0.27 / +$0.33) because the AEP-through-east internal cuts (AEP->DOM 4050, West_APS->SWMAAC 3900, Central_PA->EMAAC ~8090) do NOT bind hard enough to lift the east: the western bituminous belt still reaches the east within the measured line ratings. So the residual is a price-LEVEL problem (PJM clears too cheap -> gas-CC over-runs, coal under-runs, over-exports), NOT a cross-zonal-spread problem -- the network redistributes price (ComEd cheap) but cannot raise the level. The next lever must make PJM fossil DEARER / CAP the priced export sink (the +50 over-export keeps the internal level low), which is what lets both this measured congestion and the pjm-53 zonal gas pricing finally lift the load-weighted LMP and back the gas-CC over-run off. C6 PASS (measured network inputs, no residual fit, exogenous historic outages). DESIGNATED THE PJM KEEPER on STRUCTURAL FAITHFULNESS (rule #1: a keeper is the most structurally faithful run, explicitly not the lowest-fit run) -- pjm-54 carries strictly MORE correct measured market structure than pjm-53 (the same fully-attested stack PLUS the measured transmission congestion that makes pjm-53's already-correct zonal gas pricing finally non-inert, opening the LMP spread pjm-53 left at exactly zero). This is NOT a fit pass: the determination is NOT-YET and the dominant misses (gas-CC over-run, under-pricing, over-export, COAL_BIT under) remain OPEN, now traced to the still-missing export-cap / fossil-dearness LEVEL structure rather than to the network.
